validation.reason: Need at least 500 sourced historical races and 2,000 full-field runner observations; not trained or validated

methodology: Every prospective feature must predate the subject race; store dated evidence with a direct source. No blind race comment classification counts as verified improvement. Racewise chronological tests against a market baseline must demonstrate improvement before changing live selection scoring.
developmentState: Research-only feature engineering, no automatic model retraining, paper picks unchanged.
